comments.text:
I recently stopped two thieves in a car park. After parking, it took me a while to gather my things. Meanwhile, I noticed an elderly lady taking her time to park in the space next to mine.

I headed into town for a meeting before returning to my car. I'd forgotten exactly where I'd parked, but eventually I spotted it. The lady who had parked beside me had also returned from shopping. As I approached, I realised she was being distracted by one man while his accomplice was helping himself to her purse, which was on the passenger-side footwell. I caught him red-handed.

I shouted, "Thief!" as loudly as I could to draw as much attention as possible. The man dropped the purse, allowing me to return it to the lady. Both thieves immediately fled the scene. I'm not in any shape to give chase, but at least they left empty-handed. 

I checked in on her, she was fine, surprisingly resilient, smiling whilst saying "sh!t happens", I called the police on the non emergency number but don't expect to hear back from them.
